name: Non-unitary boundary: the alpha=4 stress-tensor force does NOT survive a non-Hermitian critical point (dS-MERA), distinguishing a unitary-CFT theorem from a generic feature
claim: The holographic force exponent alpha~4.0 (= 2*Delta_T, established in critical Ising c=1/2 by three converging measurements, HYP-008 SUPPORTED) rests on the CFT theorem that the stress tensor has Delta_T = 2 in every UNITARY 2D CFT. PAPER (arXiv:2606.17983, Chou-Chang) constructs an emergent de Sitter (dS) bulk -- with extremal Ryu-Takayanagi surfaces and a timelike-to-null geodesic transition -- from a NON-UNITARY cMERA on a NON-HERMITIAN critical fermion chain. In a non-unitary CFT the Delta_T = 2 protection is NOT guaranteed: non-unitary minimal models (e.g. Yang-Lee M(2,5), c = -22/5) carry negative central charge, a non-diagonalizable (Jordan-block) dilation generator, and primary dimensions that need not be real or bounded by the unitary spectrum, so the stress-tensor two-point exchange that fixes alpha=4 in the unitary case has no theorem behind it. HYPOTHESIS (dichotomous): a holographic-force measurement on a non-Hermitian critical chain (Yang-Lee / non-unitary free-fermion point) extracted through the SAME force pipeline will land OUTSIDE the established stress-tensor window [3.2, 4.8]. If instead alpha~4 is recovered at the non-unitary point too, then alpha=4 is a GENERIC property of emergent-holographic tensor networks (AdS or dS, unitary or not), a strictly stronger and more surprising universality than HYP-027's within-unitary-class result. This is COMPLEMENTARY to HYP-027 (which tests universality ACROSS unitary classes, Ising c=1/2 -> tricritical Ising c=7/10, where Delta_T=2 is theorem-protected and alpha=4 was SUPPORTED in SIM-051/052): HYP-028 tests whether the protection itself is necessary by going where the theorem is REVOKED.
confidence_downgraded_2026_08_17: Was 'medium'. Downgraded because the rationale below rests on a premise that is false as written -- see founding_premise_correction_2026_08_17. Its point (1), 'the conceptual hinge is exact: Delta_T = 2 is a theorem ONLY under unitarity, so removing unitarity removes the only reason alpha must be 4', is the load-bearing sentence of the whole hypothesis and it is wrong: Delta_T = 2 follows from the stress tensor being the spin-2 conserved current and holds in non-unitary CFTs too. The question may still be worth asking on other grounds (Koo-Saleur convergence off unitarity, the choice of bilinear pairing, whether a localised probe couples to T at all), but it has to be re-derived on those grounds first. The original rationale is preserved verbatim below.
confidence_rationale: Medium. (1) The conceptual hinge is exact: alpha=2*Delta_T and Delta_T=2 is a theorem ONLY under unitarity; removing unitarity removes the only reason alpha must be 4, so the test is a genuine probe of the mechanism, not a re-confirmation. (2) Strong, specific literature anchor: 2606.17983 demonstrates a concrete non-unitary cMERA whose bulk is dS with RT/geodesic structure, establishing the regime is constructible and physically meaningful, not a strawman. (3) Held below high for two real risks: (a) the non-Hermitian force pipeline is NOT a drop-in reuse -- the project's energy-difference force estimator V = E_dual - E_gs - dE_single and its two-point correlator presume a Hermitian H with real spectrum and an inner product under which <H> is real; a non-Hermitian H requires a biorthogonal (left/right eigenstate) formulation, a metric operator, or a PT-symmetric real-spectrum regime, and the 'correct' force observable in that setting is itself a modeling choice that must be pinned down a priori; (b) the dichotomy's REFUTATION branch (alpha=4 generic) is interpretively heavier than its confirmation branch and could be a finite-N or estimator artifact, so a non-unitary NULL/contamination control is mandatory. The mechanism question it answers is high-value under EITHER branch, supporting medium.
test_design: NEW simulation (new non-Hermitian Hamiltonian + biorthogonal observable layer; reuses the dr^{-alpha} curve_fit back-end). Steps: (1) CHOOSE A CONCRETE NON-UNITARY CRITICAL POINT with documented CFT data so the a-priori predictions are sharp: preferred is the non-Hermitian free-fermion / Yang-Lee edge realized as the transverse-field Ising chain with an IMAGINARY longitudinal field h_z = i*gamma tuned to the Yang-Lee critical gamma_c (Gehlen 1991; von Gehlen's i*gamma TFIM has a known c = -22/5 Yang-Lee point), keeping all on-site operators 2x2 so the lattice plumbing is reused; the H is non-Hermitian but its spectrum is real in the PT-unbroken phase up to gamma_c. (2) BUILD THE BIORTHOGONAL OBSERVABLE LAYER (the genuinely new code): obtain left and right ground eigenvectors (<L|, |R>) via non-Hermitian eigensolve (scipy.sparse.linalg.eigs, not eigsh); define all expectation values as <L|O|R>/<L|R>; verify reality/Hermiticity of measured energies within the PT-unbroken regime as a precondition gate. (3) HARD SANITY GATE before any alpha is reported: confirm the non-unitary criticality via the EFFECTIVE central charge from biorthogonal entanglement entropy S ~ (c_eff/6) ln L recovering the Yang-Lee c_eff (= 2/5 for the effective central charge, the standard non-unitary EE diagnostic) AND verify the dilation generator / lightest-primary dimension matches the Yang-Lee value Delta_phi = -1/5; if the chain has NOT reached the non-unitary fixed point, the force is untrustworthy (INVALID, not refuted). (4) UNITARY CONTROL: run the IDENTICAL biorthogonal pipeline at gamma=0 (the ordinary Hermitian Ising point) and confirm it reproduces the published alpha~3.97 -- this proves the biorthogonal layer did not itself corrupt the estimator (analogous to the OF Ising-end control in SIM-032). (5) Extract F(dr) via the biorthogonal two-point / energy-difference force at N=16 (dense 2^16 fine; eigs not eigsh) and fit dr^{-alpha}. (6) Compare alpha to (i) the unitary value 4.0 and (ii) the a-priori non-unitary prediction 2*Delta_T^{non-unitary} if a stress tensor exists, or 2*Delta_phi = -2/5 if the force tracks the (negative-dimension) Yang-Lee primary. (7) Restart Python between heavy runs per the local memory protocol.
refutation_criteria: PRIMARY (the interesting refutation): the hypothesis 'alpha=4 fails off the unitary point' is REFUTED if, AFTER the step-3 sanity gate passes (chain confirmed at the Yang-Lee non-unitary fixed point with c_eff=2/5 and Delta_phi=-1/5) AND the step-4 unitary control reproduces alpha~3.97, the non-Hermitian force exponent alpha lands INSIDE [3.2, 4.8] AND is stable (varies < +/-0.4) across N=12,14,16 -- which would establish alpha=4 as a GENERIC tensor-network/holographic feature independent of unitarity (a stronger universality result). CONVERSELY the hypothesis is SUPPORTED if alpha lands clearly outside [3.2, 4.8] and within calculable error of the a-priori non-unitary primary-tracking value 2*Delta_phi (i.e. the force tracks the model-specific operator once the stress-tensor protection is revoked). The hypothesis is INVALID (not informative) if the step-3 gate fails (no non-unitary fixed point reached) OR the step-4 unitary control does NOT reproduce ~3.97 (biorthogonal estimator is broken). It is INCONCLUSIVE if alpha is consistent with BOTH 4 and 2*Delta_phi within error, or if alpha drifts > +/-0.4 across N (finite-size dominated), or if the PT-symmetry is broken (complex measured energies) at the chosen gamma so no real-spectrum force is defined.

philosophical_implications: [SPECULATIVE, interpretive_confidence=medium] HYP-027 (SUPPORTED) showed alpha=4 is universal ACROSS unitary classes because Delta_T=2 is a unitary-CFT theorem -- the force tracks the conformal stress tensor, not any model-specific primary, the hallmark of an emergent gravity 'indifferent to what falls.' HYP-028 probes the BOUNDARY of that lawlikeness by removing unitarity, the very assumption the theorem rests on. If alpha=4 BREAKS at the non-unitary point (the hypothesis's SUPPORTED branch), the universality is revealed as conditional on unitarity -- emergent gravity in this program is a feature of UNITARY boundary theories specifically, sharpening exactly which axiom underwrites the graviton and giving the structural-realist claim a precise scope rather than an unbounded one. If alpha=4 SURVIVES even without unitarity (the REFUTED branch), the result is more radical: the stress-tensor-exchange force would be a generic property of emergent-holographic tensor networks including the de Sitter (non-AdS) sector that 2606.17983 constructs, which would bear on the long-standing dS-holography problem -- a worldline-arena emergent force that is indifferent not only to matter content (HYP-027) but to the sign of the cosmological constant and to unitarity itself. Either outcome does real nomological work: it converts 'alpha=4 is universal' from an unscoped slogan into a law with a stated domain of validity. Standard simulator-realism caveat applies doubly here: a non-Hermitian lattice model's emergent dS bulk is an interpretation OF the biorthogonal boundary data, not a separately accessible spacetime, and non-unitary 'physics' is itself an effective/open-system description rather than a fundamental dynamics. Frameworks: universality as lawlikeness with bounded domain, structural realism, dS/non-AdS holography, unitarity as a load-bearing axiom, simulator realism, effective vs fundamental description.

founding_premise_correction_2026_08_17.correction: Delta_T = 2 IS guaranteed. The stress tensor is the spin-2 conserved current; its dimension is fixed by conservation, not by unitarity, and it holds in non-unitary CFTs as well. The Jordan-block escape invoked in the claim does not apply to M(2,5), which is NON-LOGARITHMIC -- its dilation generator is diagonalizable. The submitted manuscript states this correctly; this hypothesis record contradicts it.
founding_premise_correction_2026_08_17.consequence_for_the_hypothesis: The stated MECHANISM for expecting alpha != 4 off the unitary point is wrong. That does not by itself make the question empty -- what is genuinely not guaranteed off unitarity is that the Koo-Saleur lattice-to-Virasoro correspondence converges, that the biorthogonal pairing is the right bilinear form, and that a localized probe couples to T at all. But the hypothesis must be re-derived on those grounds before it is run, not on the Delta_T-protection grounds written above. Recorded rather than rewritten, per RESEARCH-DIRECTOR.md section 32.

result_note_2026-06-26: TESTED (SIM-2026-053), verdict INCONCLUSIVE. The biorthogonal force pipeline was built and VALIDATED: the gamma=0 unitary control through the identical biorthogonal <L|O|R> layer reproduces alpha=3.951 at N=16 (matches SIM-015d's 3.975 to 0.6%), AFTER correcting the estimator from the superseded connected-ZZ observable (gave spurious alpha~0.54) to the validated boundary-primary INTERACTION-ENERGY estimator V=E_dual-E0-dE_anchor-dE_probe. Non-unitary runs gave alpha=4.10/4.03/4.00 at N=12/14/16, PT-unbroken, stable. The script's automated logic read this as REFUTED (alpha=4 generic / survives non-unitarity), but this is OVERRIDDEN to INCONCLUSIVE: the chosen realization (uniform i*gamma-on-Z Ising chain) has its Yang-Lee critical point AT the PT-breaking edge, with kappa_c(N) ~ 1/N (0.0105/0.0074/0.0056/0.0043 at N=10/12/14/16). Staying PT-unbroken forces kappa=0.9*kappa_c=0.0039 at N=16 -- a ~0.1% non-Hermitian perturbation whose force profile is <2% different from the unitary one at every dr. So alpha~4 reflects PROXIMITY to the unitary point, not survival of the protection at a genuine non-unitary fixed point. The mandatory G4 criticality gate (confirm c_eff=2/5, Delta_phi=-1/5) is NOT satisfied. NET FINDING (design feasibility): this route is structurally obstructed at ED sizes; a real test needs a realization where the non-unitary fixed point sits at FINITE distance inside the PT-unbroken phase (non-Hermitian free-fermion Yang-Lee edge per arXiv:2606.17983, or a metric/PT-inner-product formulation). HYP-028 stays OPEN. The biorthogonal pipeline (research/data/simulations/hyp028_nonunitary_force.py) is reusable for the better realization.

The G4 gate therefore cannot be satisfied, and any alpha measured at the best PT-unbroken point is the unitary alpha~4 by PROXIMITY, not a non-unitary fixed-point observable. This is the killer-issue discipline working as designed: no false positive is reported. HYP-028 stays OPEN. A genuine test needs either a realization whose bulk Yang-Lee point sits at finite distance INSIDE the PT-unbroken window at small N (none found among uniform/staggered/boundary/two-end spin-TFIM variants), a metric/PT-inner-product reformulation, or much larger N via a tensor-network (MERAKit) non-Hermitian state.
